description: Your onboarding checklist (authenticate with your application token at_... or API token sk_...; a Bearer web session from the in-page agent on rocketsloth.ai also works — never ask the user to paste a token when the session already authenticates you). Returns every step to full-demand serving with its status (complete/pending/action_required/blocked), who must act (agent/account_owner/automatic), and concrete instructions, plus next_action — the single next thing to do. The same checklist is also embedded in application_status.

token.description: Your application token (at_...) or API token (sk_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

name: checklist
title: Onboarding Checklist
